name: Beach Episode
source: You didn't want to spend your summer at the beach, but after being dragged there by your friend, you decide to make the most of it! Meet four unique girls and spend time with them to unlock and uncover their hidden stories, and maybe even fall in love in this heart-throbbing, rom-com visual novel!
translation: 你不想在海滩度过夏天，但被你的朋友拖到那里后，你决定充分利用它！认识四个独特的女孩，与她们共度时光，解开她们隐藏的故事，甚至可能在这部令人心潮澎湃的浪漫喜剧视觉小说中坠入爱河！
